summary: 채팅 전송은 텍스트·준비된 첨부와 명령 권한으로 판단하고, 수정 대상 해제는 미선택으로 돌리며 기존 제어 경로 위에 공통 UI를 적용한다.
invariants: Send requires text or ready attachments, command support, valid permissions and an explicit target for edits.
Initial edit scope and cleared or invalid targets are unselected; preserve drafts and require explicit reselection.
Generation cancellation uses the composer action bound to its operation; server state confirms cancellation.
Separate server confirmation from actual progress; 60 seconds without progress only triggers information, never automatic retry.
Share presentation components and adapters while preserving existing controllers, transports, provider and page lifetimes.
Use representative visual, boundary-width and long-history acceptance cases; design and old test results do not prove implementation.
forbidden: Automatically widen a cleared slide target to the whole deck.
Silently omit an included failed attachment.
Create a replacement monolithic host or duplicate generation and polling loops.
